summary: Unconditional __thiscall initializer: writes 0 to three consecutive dwords at this (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8) and returns the this pointer. No branches, no calls, no globals.

operations.description: Write 0 to this+0x0 (first dword of the triple).
Write 0 to this+0x4 (second dword of the triple).
Write 0 to this+0x8 (third dword of the triple).
Return the this pointer as the result.

unresolved: Identity of the struct owning the three zeroed dwords is unknown; object type and the meaning of each field are not established.
